summary: EA and Maxis's life-simulation series, covering the main numbered games, major standalone story/online/mobile spinoffs, legacy collections, and the announced Project Rene.

entries.title: The Sims

primary.why: The 2025 Legacy Collection re-released the original game for Windows 10/11 and includes all seven original expansion packs, making it the most complete current route.
primary.how_to_play: Play The Sims: Legacy Collection on Windows through EA app, Steam, or Epic Games Store.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console adaptations are distinct but not the main complete PC route.

entries.title: The Sims Online

primary.why: The Sims Online was a Windows online service later rebranded EA-Land and shut down, so the final service build is the authentic version.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route remains after service closure; preserve through archival documentation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Service closure prevents normal official play.

entries.title: The Sims 2

primary.why: The 2025 Legacy Collection includes The Sims 2 plus the major expansion and stuff packs, making it the most complete current route.
primary.how_to_play: Play The Sims 2: Legacy Collection on Windows through EA app, Steam, or Epic Games Store.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console/handheld Sims 2 games are distinct adaptations; they are not required for the core PC route.

entries.title: The Sims Life Stories

emulation.notes: Use original PC/Mac release where compatible.

primary.why: Life Stories is a standalone laptop-friendly Sims Stories title with structured stories and classic mode; no later definitive edition was identified.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Windows or Mac release where compatible.

entries.remaster_caveats: Compatibility on modern systems may require preservation work.

entries.title: The Sims Pet Stories

emulation.notes: Use original PC/Mac release where compatible.

primary.why: Pet Stories is the second standalone Sims Stories title and no later definitive edition was identified.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Windows or Mac release where compatible.

entries.remaster_caveats: Compatibility on modern systems may require preservation work.

entries.title: The Sims Castaway Stories

emulation.notes: Use original PC/Mac release where compatible.

primary.why: Castaway Stories is the third and final Sims Stories title, with a structured castaway story and sandbox mode; no later definitive edition was identified.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Windows or Mac release where compatible.

entries.remaster_caveats: Compatibility on modern systems may require preservation work.

entries.title: The Sims 3

primary.why: The Sims 3's PC version has the full expansion/stuff-pack ecosystem and the highest fidelity/control ceiling compared with console and mobile adaptations.
primary.how_to_play: Play The Sims 3 on Windows with the desired expansions and current compatibility fixes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern Windows may require compatibility tuning for a large mod/expansion setup.

entries.title: The Sims Medieval

primary.why: The Sims Medieval is a PC/Mac standalone spinoff; the current EA digital route is the practical Windows version.
primary.how_to_play: Play The Sims Medieval on Windows via EA app where available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Availability and compatibility vary by storefront/client.

entries.title: The Sims Social

primary.why: The Sims Social was a browser/Facebook social game that shut down, so its final service build is the only authentic version.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route remains after service closure; preserve through archival documentation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Service closure prevents normal official play.

entries.title: The Sims FreePlay

primary.why: FreePlay is a mobile Sims service game for iOS and Android; mobile hardware is the authentic route.
primary.how_to_play: Play The Sims FreePlay on supported Android or iOS hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service availability and regional storefront support are the main caveats.

entries.title: The Sims 4
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with selected packs

primary.version: Current PC release with expansion/game/stuff/kit library
primary.why: The PC release has the broadest expansion and mod ecosystem plus the highest fidelity/configuration ceiling, while the base game is available free-to-play.
primary.how_to_play: Play The Sims 4 on Windows through EA app, Steam, or Epic Games Store with desired packs installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: There is no single complete edition because pack ownership is modular and ongoing.

entries.title: The Sims Mobile

primary.why: The Sims Mobile was an Android/iOS service title and shut down in January 2026; the final service build is the authentic version.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route remains after service closure; preserve through archival documentation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Service shutdown prevents normal official play.

primary.why: Project Rene is in development as a future Sims project with PC/mobile collaborative playtesting, but no final shipped version exists.
primary.how_to_play: Do not assign a play route until release platforms, content model, and final builds are verified.
